description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LeavePeriodDao class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, focusing on testing leave period history saving, retrieval, and entitlement adjustment logic.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for LeavePeriodDao, covering functionalities such as saving leave period history, retrieving current leave periods, and adjusting entitlements upon leave period changes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the LeavePeriodDao and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryFirstTime
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave period history when no previous period exists.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Tests updating leave period history when a current leave period exists.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions during leave period saving are properly handled and transaction is rolled back.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the current leave period's start date and month.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Checks that the list of leave period histories is correctly retrieved and ordered.

methods.name: testEntitlementChangeWhenLeavePeriodChanged
methods.description: Verifies correct adjustment of employee leave entitlements when the leave period changes, including date recalculations and entitlement updates.
